correctness.rationale: Renewal equation for since-last-reset count gives F(s+lambda(1−z))/(sF(s)); an iid-wait count would give (1−w(s))/(s(1−zw(s))). Equality for all spatial characteristic functions forces equality of count generating functions, so 1/F is affine on each overlapping interval [s,s+lambda], hence globally s+r (r>=0). Laplace uniqueness and normalization imply Phi=e^(−rt) and unique defective w(s)=lambda/(s+lambda+r). Conversely transform identity yields all-time marginal equality. Two-time covariance follows reset erasure vs killed martingale; regenerative ergodic theorem gives time-average separation r>0. Independently checked 135 exponential-transform parameter tuples and three deterministic-reset nonaffinity examples. Scope excludes delayed/nonrenewal surrogates.
